maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is theme park admissions, in-park food, merchandise and passes from guests, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumer park visitors buying tickets, passes, food and merchandise at SeaWorld, Busch Gardens and Sesame Place.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through park attendance, pricing, new rides and attractions; its parks portfolio is long established, with no steady acquisition stream.

mission_critical.reason: Leisure entertainment; guests can easily choose other theme parks or activities, with no switching cost or regulatory barrier.
